metadata.provider_scope: Own C++ scalar/runtime AVX2 coordinates; NumPy fitting/SVD/normalization/inversion/composition and policy replay; SciPy3D Euler provider. No pure-C++ fitting claim.
metadata.timing_scope: Warmed allocation/destruction inclusive public calls. Immutable fixtures/models excluded; constructor-plus-estimate includes fresh state reset each iteration. Warnings checked then suppressed symmetrically.
